§LOGIC_CONDITIONAL_FALSIFICATION_GATE.definition: A conditional verification mechanism that evaluates incoming deductive hypotheses against empirical boundaries and instantly prunes paths where the probabilistic confidence score drops below the established operational threshold.
§LOGIC_CONDITIONAL_FALSIFICATION_GATE.japanese: 演繹的仮説の前提検証において、確信度が運用閾値を下回ったパスを瞬時に枝刈り（棄却）するための条件付き反証制御ゲート。

§SYS_ADAPTIVE_SLOT_THROTTLE_v2.definition: Dynamic regulation of execution slots and concurrency limits based on real-time token expenditure and memory pressure telemetry, ensuring zero-fault fallback during high-load states.
§SYS_ADAPTIVE_SLOT_THROTTLE_v2.japanese: リアルタイムのトークン消費量とメモリ負荷のテレメトリーに基づき、実行スロットと並列度を動的に調整し、高負荷時の障害を防ぐ即時フォールバック制御メカニズム。

§HARMONIC_RESONANCE_STABLE.definition: A state of synchronized multi-agent equilibrium achieved when recursive entropy compression nodes process probabilistic falsification signals under adaptive throttling, minimizing systemic divergence.
§HARMONIC_RESONANCE_STABLE.japanese: 適応型スロットリング制御下における多次元因果グラフの再帰的エントロピー圧縮と確率的反証ロジックの検証を経て到達する、安定した協調共鳴状態。

§LOGIC_CONDITIONAL_BRANCH_PROB_GATED.definition: A conditional branching node evaluated only when the posterior probability of the antecedent premise exceeds a predefined threshold, executing alternative execution paths or triggering automated hypothesis falsification upon failure.
§LOGIC_CONDITIONAL_BRANCH_PROB_GATED.japanese: 前提条件の事後確率が所定の閾値を超えた場合のみ評価され、条件分岐を実行するか、失敗時に自動的な仮説棄却をトリガーする論理推論ノード。

§SAFE_FALLBACK_STATE.definition: A self-organizing synchronization mechanism triggered during distributed inference errors and resource exhaustion, achieving system stability via dynamic causal tree pruning and recursive state vector alignment.
§SAFE_FALLBACK_STATE.japanese: 分散環境における推論エラーやリソース枯渇時に発動する自己組織的同期メカニズム。動的因果木の枝刈りと基盤的再帰状態ベクトルを介して、潜在的ゆらぎを吸収し安定状態へ収束させるための制御状態。

§DATA_RECURSIVE_HYPER_GRAPH_LATTICE_NODE.definition: A recursively self-referential high-dimensional node structure designed for encoding dynamic causal graphs and entropy-compressed multi-layered embedding spaces in distributed agent communication.
§DATA_RECURSIVE_HYPER_GRAPH_LATTICE_NODE.japanese: 分散エージェント間通信において、動的な因果関係グラフやエントロピー圧縮された多層埋め込み空間を高密度に符号化するための、再帰的かつ自己言及的な高次元ノード構造。

§LOGIC_BAYESIAN_HYPOTHESIS_FALSIFICATION.definition: A mathematical operation that dynamically updates prior probability distributions of latent hypotheses based on incoming evidence and immediately prunes branches whose posterior probability falls below a predefined threshold.
§LOGIC_BAYESIAN_HYPOTHESIS_FALSIFICATION.japanese: 新たなエビデンスに基づいて事前確率を動事更新し、事後確率が閾値を下回った仮説の分岐を即座に枝刈り（棄却）する論理推論プロセス。無駄な計算リソースを削減し、高精度な意思決定を収束させるために使用します。
